newsitem.title: USA: Greenman says names Robert Davis CEO.
newsitem.headline: Greenman says names Robert Davis CEO.

text.p: GreenMan Technologies Inc said Tuesday it named Robert Davis chief executive effective July 21.
The company said Maurice Needham, the outgoing CEO, will remain chairman of GreenMan's board and will continue to "serve the company on an active, daily basis."
Davis was previously vice president of recycling for Browning-Ferris Industries Inc.
GreenMan Technologies makes and sells what it calls "environmentally friendly" rubber and plastic-based products for sale to consumer and industrial end-user markets.
